description: This file defines a Blazor layout component class 'BlazorLayoutComponent' that manages refresh logic using a singleton 'RefreshBroadcast'. It registers an event handler for refresh requests and triggers UI updates accordingly.

classes.name: BlazorLayoutComponent
classes.description: A Blazor layout component that listens for refresh requests and refreshes the UI when triggered.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Overrides the base method to subscribe to the refresh event.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Public method to initiate a refresh request via the refresh broadcast.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Event handler that invokes UI refresh when a refresh is requested.
